item.title: Show HN: A MitM proxy to see what your LLM tools are sending
item.description:
📝 Start Sherlock sherlock On first run, Sherlock will: Generate the mitmproxy CA certificate Prompt you to install it in your system trust store Ask where to save intercepted prompts 2. Run Your LLM Tools In a separate terminal, use Sherlock to proxy your commands: # For Claude Code sherlock claude # For any command sherlock run --node your-llm-tool That's it. git cd sherlock python -m.
